announcements.title: ![RocketRide](assets/rocketride.svg) RocketRide Cloud is Live
announcements.body: Offload the heavy lifting of production AI with **RocketRide Cloud**: shared pipelines, no-hassle infra, and a fraction of the cost on our patent-pending model server. Sign up to start building.

announcements.title: ![RocketRide](assets/rocketride.svg) Introducing the RocketRide Cloud Starter Plan, From $5/mo
announcements.body: The new **Starter plan** puts RocketRide Cloud at **$5/month** with 500 tokens included, then $0.03/token as you scale. Design in VS Code, hit deploy, and run your pipeline on a live, API-callable endpoint.

announcements.title: ![RocketRide](assets/rocketride.svg) 7,000 Stars and 19,000 Downloads
announcements.body: RocketRide just crossed **7,000 GitHub stars** and **19,000 downloads**, thanks to everyone building with us. Star the repo and come build something.

announcements.title: ![Discord](assets/discord.svg) Join our Discord
announcements.body: Connect with the RocketRide team and builders on **Discord**.

announcements.title: ![Hackathon](assets/trophy.svg) Memory Meets Motion - SF
announcements.body: 8-hour hackathon on **long-term AI memory and autonomous agents** in **San Francisco** on August 3, 2026. RocketRide × FalkorDB.

announcements.title: ![Hackathon](assets/trophy.svg) SF Enterprise Hackathon
announcements.body: One-day **enterprise AI** hackathon at **AWS Builder Loft, San Francisco** on August 14, 2026. Sponsored by RocketRide, with free Cloud credits for participants.

announcements.title: ![Hackathon](assets/trophy.svg) RocketRide Buildathon: From Idea to Million-Dollar App
announcements.body: The **RocketRide Buildathon** comes to four Indian cities from **August 22 to 29**: Lucknow, Delhi, Hyderabad, and Mumbai. Take your idea from blank canvas to a million-dollar app with RocketRide Cloud and register now.

announcements.title: ![Hackathon](assets/trophy.svg) RocketRide × SCU Buildathon
announcements.body: A week-long **online hackathon** with **Santa Clara University's AI Collaborate**, Aug 31 to Sep 6: build an AI pipeline that solves a real problem, publish it on RocketRide, and get it used. Open to any university; register now.

announcements.title: ![Hackathon](assets/trophy.svg) Data & AI Hackathon - SF
announcements.body: 8-hour **data and AI** hackathon at **AWS Builder Loft, San Francisco** on September 11, 2026. Partnered with RocketRide, with free Cloud credits for participants.

announcements.title: ![Build](assets/code-brackets.svg) SF Tech Week: Zero to Agent with Mansi More
announcements.body: **Mansi More** leads a hands-on **SF Tech Week** workshop on **October 6**: build an agentic workflow from an empty project, with RocketRide shown as a real production example. Build alongside, not just watch.

announcements.title: ![Build](assets/code-brackets.svg) LA Tech Week: Build an AI App on RocketRide
announcements.body: **Joshua** runs a hands-on build session at **LA Tech Week** on **October 15**: go from a visual canvas to a deployed webhook-to-agent pipeline on RocketRide Cloud, no local setup. Join the workshop.

announcements.title: ![Discord](assets/discord.svg) RocketRide Office Hours
announcements.body: Join **RocketRide Office Hours**, a fortnightly technical session on building and running AI pipelines, live on Discord with screen-sharing and Q&A. Register for the next session.

announcements.title: ![Event](assets/trophy.svg) SF AI Summit
announcements.body: A full-day **SF AI Summit** in **San Francisco** on **October 21, 2026**: founders, engineers, researchers, and investors across AI, in one room. Register now.

announcements.title: ![Hackathon](assets/trophy.svg) HackwithBay 4.0
announcements.body: 8-hour hackathon on **Thoughtful Agents for Productivity** at **AWS Builder Loft, San Francisco** on **November 24, 2026**. Build, compete for prizes, and demo to industry leaders.

announcements.title: ![Event](assets/trophy.svg) AI Demo Night
announcements.body: **AI Demo Night** at **AWS Builder Loft, San Francisco** on **December 4, 2026**: live product showcases from founders and AI builders, plus networking. Register now.
